title: List the current user's Part Request tasks
summary: Queries the workspace task service (IEDMS_TaskService.GetPartRequestTasks) for the signed-in user's Part Request tasks and lists each task's HRID, GUID, state, description and assignee. Shows how to reach the EDMS task service and configure a task search.
phrasings: get my part requests from the workspace
query workspace tasks assigned to me
use the EDMS task service from an extension
check if Altium Designer is signed in to a workspace

commands.name: GetPartRequests
commands.description: List the current user's Part Request tasks
commands.params: Max=<lines, default 50> (optional)|Sort=<field, default CreatedAt> (optional)|Names=true (optional: resolve assignee names)
